To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the novel compounds 4 and 5 are potent inhibitors of the testicular cell lines 833K, NT2/D1 and 769P.

the novel compounds BIBX1382 (BIBX) and BIBX1528 (BIBX1528) have anti-tumour activity in cisplatin-resistant germ cell tumours and that this activity is mediated by the inhibition of the cell cycle regulator Aurora kinase B.

the two compounds, N-[(4-chlorophenyl)sulfonyl]-N-ethyl-N-methylamine (CSE) and N-[(2,6-dimethylphenyl)sulfonylamino]methyl-N-ethyl-N-methanamine (DME), exhibit anti-tumour activity in vitro and in vivo in cisplatin-resistant testicular cancer cells.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of novel anticancer agents.
the identification of compounds that inhibit cell growth by blocking the function of the transcription factor NF-κB.
the development of novel anticancer drugs that target the DNA damage response.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the combination of the novel compounds, 2-oxopiperidin-3-one (2-OP) and 2-oxo-1,2,3,4-tetrahydroquinoline (2-OQ) with cisplatin is superior to cisplatin alone in the treatment of cisplatin-resistant testicular germ cell cancer.
the anti-tumor activity of 2 novel compounds in cisplatin-resistant testicular germ cell tumors was investigated in vitro and in vivo.
the anti-tumour activity of the novel compounds is not yet established in cisplatin-resistant testicular germ cell cancer.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the combination of cisplatin with the novel agents (1) and (3) is effective in vitro in a panel of 10 cell lines, including the cisplatin-resistant cell lines CTC-1 and CTC-2.

we identified a novel class of drugs, the so-called histone deacetylase (HDAC) inhibitor, which has a strong anti-proliferative effect on cisplatin resistant germ cell cancer cells and that the mechanism of action of the compounds seems to be different than other HDAC inhibitors.

the 2 novel drugs, 2-aminobenzothiazole (2-ABT) and 4-aminobenzamide (4-ABA) have anti-cancer effects in vitro and in vivo in testicular germ cell cancer (TGCC) and that 2-ABT has a better anti-cancer effect than 4-ABA.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we have developed 2 novel compounds that show activity against cisplatin-resistant testicular germ cell cancer.

the combination of cisplatin and the novel compound 5-F-4-AP (5-fluoropyrazolo[1,5- a]pyrimidine-4-amine) is highly active in testicular germ cell tumours, including cisplatin-resistant tumours, and that the combination of the two drugs may have the potential to become a new standard therapy for testicular cancer.

the combination of the 3 drugs (cisplatin, ifosfamide and paclitaxel) is still the standard treatment of choice for patients with metastatic testicular germ cell tumors (TGCTs), but the addition of the new compounds, the platinum analogues BBR3464 and BBR3610, to the standard 3-drug combination is able to overcome resistance to cisplatin in cisplatin-resistant TGCT cells.
